mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.externalapi.ExternalApiMapper.getUserCntrInfo 민간개방 API 결제 상태 조회 */ SELECT A.CNTR_SN , A.CNTR_DE , A.USER_ID , A.PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE , A.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE , A.CNTR_AMT , A.CNTR_BLCE_POINT , A.ELCTRN_PAY_NO , A.SEOUL_TRGET_AT , A.CNTR_STTUS_CODE , A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE , A.FOREIGN_STATUS_CODE , A.CNTR_POINT , A.RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE , B.USER_NAME AS USER_NAME , C.BIRTHDAY AS BIRTHDAY FROM G_CNTR A LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_USER B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL C ON A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{epayno} AND (A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE IS NULL OR TRIM(A.STTEMNT_PAY_DE) = '') AND A.DELETE_AT = 'N' AND A.CNTR_STTUS_CODE <> '200'
mapper.update: /* saleson.shop.externalapi.ExternalApiMapper.sunapSuccess 민간개방 API 수납완료 처리 */ UPDATE G_CNTR GC SET GC.CNTR_POINT = CASE WHEN GC.RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE = '100' THEN (GC.CNTR_AMT *(SELECT POINT_RATE FROM G_CTBNY_SETUP WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND STDR_YEAR = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y') )/100) WHEN GC.RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE = '300' THEN 0 END , GC.CNTR_BLCE_POINT = CASE WHEN GC.RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE = '100' THEN (GC.CNTR_AMT *(SELECT POINT_RATE FROM G_CTBNY_SETUP WHERE LOCGOV_CODE = GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE AND STDR_YEAR = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y') )/100) WHEN RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE = '300' THEN 0 END , GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE = IFNULL(#{sttemntPayDe}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d')) , GC.POINT_END_DE = CASE WHEN gc.RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE = '100' THEN DATE_FORMAT(ADDDATE( NOW() , INTERVAL+5 YEAR),'%Y%m%d') WHEN GC.RTNPSNT_REQST_CODE = '300' THEN NULL END , GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE = '200' , GC.LAST_UPDUSR_ID = GC.USER_ID , GC.DELETE_AT = 'N' , GC.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') WHERE GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{enapbuNo}
mapper.select: /* saleson.shop.externalapi.ExternalApiMapper.getSmsSendGiveUserInfo */ SELECT A.USER_ID , MBER_CI , USER_NAME AS USER_NAME , CONCAT(LOC.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, ' ', LOC.LOCGOV_NM) AS LOCGOV_NM , B.CNTR_AMT , C.RECEIVE_SMS , REPLACE (C.PHONE_NUMBER,'-','') AS PHONE_NUMBER FROM G_CNTR B INNER JOIN OP_USER A ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL C ON A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID JOIN G_LOCGOV LOC ON LOC.LOCGOV_CODE = B.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND B.ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{enapbuNo}

/* saleson.shop.externalapi.ExternalApiMapper.getCntrInfoByPayNo 민간개방 API 기부정보 조회 */
SELECT GC.CNTR_SN , GC.CNTR_DE , GC.CNTR_AMT , GC.CNTR_STTUS_CODE , GC.STTEMNT_PAY_DE , GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO , GC.SEOUL_TRGET_AT , GC.PSITN_LOCGOV_CODE , GC.CNTR_LOCGOV_CODE FROM G_CNTR GC WHERE GC.ELCTRN_PAY_NO = #{enapbuNo} AND GC.DELETE_AT = 'N'
